summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Jade & Co. Backend pytest suite 18/18 PASSED covering auth (register/login/logout/me/duplicate/wrong-password), PayPal (create-order, create-plan auth+invalid-freq, record-subscription with active-membership + previous-replaced), admin endpoints with 403-for-members and 401-anonymous. Frontend E2E via Playwright: landing hero CTAs present, registration -> /dashboard OK, google-login-btn present on /login and /register, tribute flow /join step1->step2->step3 renders paypal-checkout with no paypal-plan-error (recurring plan created), one-time /one-time skips rhythm and shows guest-name/guest-email + paypal-checkout, /api/paypal/record-subscription persists a recurring tribute that appears in /tributes/me and in tribute-history on the member dashboard with active membership + total_contributed reflecting it, admin login redirects to /admin and renders admin-stats + admin-members-table + admin-tributes-table with real data, member visiting /admin is redirected to /dashboard. Cookie-based JWT auth works (httpOnly + credentials).
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx: Promise.all().finally(setLoading(false)) will render and crash on stats.total_members if any admin endpoint fails; wrap with .catch to show an error state instead of a white screen.
PayPalCheckout: if create-plan succeeds but PayPal SDK fails to load (network/adblock), the container renders empty with no fallback message. Consider adding a script-load error handler.
AuthContext initial state uses null vs false convention; guard routes should treat loading state explicitly to avoid flicker.
Backend server.py is a single ~470 line file; acceptable for MVP but consider splitting auth/paypal/admin routers into separate modules for maintainability.
test_credentials: Admin admin@jadeandco.com / JadeAdmin123! (works). Members registered dynamically per run.
seed_data_creation: Registered a few TEST_ members and recorded 2 recurring subscriptions via /api/paypal/record-subscription (I-TEST... and I-DUMMY-... ids) to validate dashboard aggregation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PayPal sandbox buyer approval flow was intentionally NOT executed (no sandbox buyer credentials); only paypal-checkout container render + create-order/create-plan 200 + record-subscription persistence were validated per instructions. Landing 401s on /api/auth/me are expected (unauthenticated visitor). Admin dashboard initially appeared to be stuck in loading in one screenshot due to Playwright timing (screenshot taken before Promise.all resolved) — retested and all three admin endpoints returned 200 and the UI rendered correctly.
